source_policy.allowed_sources: Official live institution catalog indexes, current catalog content, and official institution pages only.
source_policy.edition_rule: The institution's live current-catalog index controls the catalog year. A yearless program URL is usable only after the current-catalog landing page has been validated in the same capture.
source_policy.selection_rule: Preserve each published award and required track choice. Do not merge award choices, tracks, minors, transfer-completion awards, or historical variants into a neutral Computer Science degree.
source_policy.plan_exclusion_rule: Sample four-year sequences, recommended schedules, prospective degree plans, and marketing plans are not categorical requirement authority and are excluded even when their arithmetic appears to repair a catalog inconsistency.
source_policy.unknown_rule: A null or unresolved operator means the current official source does not support an automatic choice or numeric value; it must not be interpreted as zero or filled from a sample plan.
source_policy.course_identity_rule: Use the catalog's current course code plus its official course-description URL or PDF page/anchor. CleanCatalog node IDs are retained as transport identities, not as substitutes for course codes.
